title: Detailed candle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='flameGlow' cx='50%' cy='60%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFBE6'/>
      <stop offset='40%' stop-color='#FFD54F'/>
      <stop offset='75%' stop-color='#FF8F00'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF6D00' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='candleBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#F5E6D3'/>
      <stop offset='30%' stop-color='#FFF8EE'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FFF8EE'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E8D5BC'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='waxDrip' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFDF5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F0DCC0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='holder' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#D4A843'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#B8860B'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8B6508'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wickGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5D4037'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3E2723'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Ambient glow behind flame -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='22' ry='24' fill='url(#flameGlow)' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- Holder base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='22' ry='6' fill='#6B4F0A'/>
  <rect x='30' y='84' width='40' height='5' rx='2' fill='url(#holder)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='20' ry='4' fill='#D4A843'/>
  <rect x='34' y='78' width='32' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='url(#holder)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='16' ry='3.5' fill='#E8C04A'/>

  <!-- Candle body -->
  <rect x='38' y='42' width='24' height='37' rx='2' fill='url(#candleBody)'/>

  <!-- Wax drips on the side -->
  <path d='M38 50 Q36 50 36 54 Q36 58 38 58' fill='url(#waxDrip)'/>
  <path d='M62 55 Q64 55 64 60 Q64 64 62 64' fill='#F0DCC0'/>
  <path d='M38 62 Q35 62 35 66 Q35 70 38 70' fill='#FFFDF5'/>
  <path d='M62 44 Q65 44 65 48 Q65 52 62 52' fill='#FFF8EE'/>

  <!-- Melted wax top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='12' ry='4' fill='#FFFDF5'/>
  <path d='M38 42 Q40 38 50 37 Q60 38 62 42' fill='#FFF8EE'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='10' ry='3' fill='#FFFDF5'/>

  <!-- Wax drip down front -->
  <path d='M44 41 Q43 44 43 48 Q43 52 45 52 Q47 52 47 48 Q47 44 46 41' fill='#FFFDF5' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Wick -->
  <rect x='49' y='34' width='2' height='9' rx='1' fill='url(#wickGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='1.2' ry='1' fill='#4E342E'/>

  <!-- Flame outer glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='28' rx='9' ry='13' fill='#FFB300' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- Flame shape -->
  <path d='M50 12 Q54 20 55 26 Q56 31 54 34 Q52 37 50 37 Q48 37 46 34 Q44 31 45 26 Q46 20 50 12Z' fill='#FFC107'/>

  <!-- Flame inner -->
  <path d='M50 17 Q52 22 53 27 Q53 31 52 33 Q51 35 50 35 Q49 35 48 33 Q47 31 47 27 Q48 22 50 17Z' fill='#FFF8E1'/>

  <!-- Flame core -->
  <path d='M50 22 Q51 25 51.5 28 Q51.5 31 51 32.5 Q50.5 34 50 34 Q49.5 34 49 32.5 Q48.5 31 48.5 28 Q49 25 50 22Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- Small sparkle -->
  <circle cx='53' cy='20' r='1' fill='#FFE082' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='23' r='0.8' fill='#FFE082' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Highlight on candle body left -->
  <rect x='40' y='44' width='3' height='33' rx='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.25'/>

  <!-- Holder detail ring -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='16' ry='3.5' fill='none' stroke='#FFD54F' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
